title: Establish a threat model and supply-chain baseline for mutation-capable releases

intent.outcome: Mutation-capable releases state and enforce their trust boundary, use immutable least-privilege CI, block on security scans, and publish SBOM/provenance bound to exact artifacts.
non_goals: Claim AW is a sandbox for arbitrary untrusted repositories.
Take ownership of branch/ruleset enforcement from #2454.

owned: trusted shell admission and adversarial tests
GitHub workflows, scanner configuration, action pinning, SBOM and provenance
machine-readable security readiness policy and check

delegation.reason: User requested continuous implementation without authorizing subagents; security policy, CI controls, and readiness proof must remain one reviewable trust boundary.

next_action: Implement and prove the security/supply-chain baseline and exact release-readiness receipt.

claims: Establish a threat model and supply-chain baseline for mutation-capable releases is implemented, validated, and closed out honestly.
requirements: uv run ruff check src scripts tests
